info.name: Bhukkad API v1
info.description:
Complete Bhukkad food-delivery backend collection.

**Setup:** Import environment, run `02 - Auth > Login Customer`, then other folders.

Tokens auto-save to `accessToken`. Collection pre-request injects Bearer auth.

item.name: 02 - Auth
item.description: Run Register/Login first. Token auto-saved to environment.
